ai.title: Run() aborts user lookup and agent-run registration via AbortSignal
ai.summary: The SDK now forwards an AbortSignal through the user-lookup and agent-run-registration requests that precede the first model call, so an abort ends those requests and their backoff retries instead of waiting out a silent socket. `fetchWithRetry` checks `signal?.aborted` before each attempt and during backoff sleeps, and `runOnce` catches the abort from `getUserInfoFromApiKey` to resolve with Run cancelled by user. That button and the underlying login system previously each defined their own name for the same login method, so they could fall out of sync and stop recognizing each other. The shared name now lives in a spot that the login page can safely read without accidentally pulling in server-only code that would break the page before it even loads. If you looked, you would just see the guest login continue to work the same way it always has on a developer's machine; the difference is invisible to anyone not building the app.
